description: Phase 3 development cases for the guidance bundle. Written from Phase 2 failure CLASSES (not held-out wording): touch create tasks must carry target-size guidance, desktop grids keyboard guidance, TV players focus restoration/auto-hide, responsive tables column priority, forms validation/IME, shared screens privacy, field apps readability/offline, high-risk actions confirmation. Assertions use concern names and concept ids, never wording.
